make_environment: make a minimax environment instance by env_id with optional kwargs and wrappers
register_environment: register a new environment entry point string under a given env_id in the global registry
register_comparator: register a comparator entry point for an environment with an optional comparator_id
get_comparator: get the comparator class for a given environment id and comparator id from the registry
cls_for_env_id: get the environment class for a registered env_id by lazy-loading its entry point
